text: I think you'll really enjoy the Go-Go Garlic Bread recipe. It's a quick and easy option that fits within your 30-minute time frame, and it's vegetarian-friendly, which meets your dietary requirements. The recipe also doesn't contain any high-fat or low-fat mayonnaise, which aligns with the ingredients specified in the recipe.
